title: Vision to action
evidenceStatus: One authored screenshot and recorded caption/Jev response; offline provenance/merge probe; external metadata counted but zero external evaluations; frozen main 4c0c40d5
summary: The honest smoke test exposes a captioning failure and Jev rates evidence at 0.25, but its action label does not gather evidence or complete a task. The current repair handler also retains old caption/task metadata beside new answers. A grounded crop/OCR loop with independent task checks would turn this into a useful experiment.
strengths: The real input image and erroneous caption are both preserved and the UI clearly discloses the failure.
The record correctly calls one example a composition smoke test, not vision accuracy.
The archived upload/worker flow has progress, an 8 MB limit and cancellation; published image bytes match the original.

findings.title: Low evidence does not produce a concrete inspection step
findings.evidence: results/vision.jsonl chooses describe at 0.50 while enough_evidence is 0.25. web/src/recipes.ts:324–339 and misc.tsx:343–362 return labels without targets, crop requests or action execution.
findings.impact: Uncertainty detection cannot repair missing evidence, and the generic task has no independent success condition.
findings.fix: Define concrete goals, grounded region/evidence actions and code-owned tool budgets and abstention policy; score completed tasks.

findings.title: Repaired decisions retain old input metadata
findings.evidence: misc.tsx:343–357 sends edited description/question then merges row and reply. The synthetic offline probe retains original caption/task/model beside new answers; no request/revision guard is stored.
findings.impact: A saved decision cannot reconstruct the evidence that produced it, and late responses can appear under later edits.
findings.fix: Store exact request and image/caption/question versions, separate manual intervention from original perception, and reject stale updates.

findings.title: Repair comparison changes the protocol as well as evidence
findings.evidence: web/src/recipes.ts:321–339 asks three questions with descriptive criteria; misc.tsx:343–355 changes state keys, criteria wording and asks only two. Python compositions.py:426 is a third variant.
findings.impact: Changed answers cannot be attributed solely to caption repair.
findings.fix: Use one versioned protocol and paired original/repaired requests with fixed tasks/settings; preserve historical output separately.

findings.title: The current page cannot gather new visual evidence
findings.evidence: misc.tsx:291–365 has a fixed image and editable text, no image input, worker, crop/OCR or target overlay; alt text does not describe screenshot content.
findings.impact: Manual caption repair cannot demonstrate recovery by the perception pipeline or grounded action.
findings.fix: Add explicit local perception, source-linked crop/OCR evidence, keyboard region controls, meaningful alt text and clearly labeled manual/recorded fallback.

findings.title: One record lacks per-stage attribution
findings.evidence: Probe finds one image/task, no image hash/model revision/config/request or caption timing, transport null; 237.3 ms is gateway latency from web/src/recipes.ts:371–380.
findings.impact: Neither perception accuracy nor end-to-end speed and reproducibility are established.
findings.fix: Pin stage inputs/runtime, retain full timing/failure records and independently evaluate perception, sufficiency and task outcomes.

simulation.title: Inspect a fictional screen
simulation.description: Find and operate a named control in a sandbox dashboard by requesting numbered crops/OCR, clarifying ambiguity and proposing grounded targets. Human takeover, checkpoints and branches preserve the exact evidence state.
simulation.jevsRole: Choose the next evidence request and interpret the user goal against observed regions; never receive gold target labels.
simulation.codeRole: Own image hashes, region geometry, revisions, budgets, sandbox transitions, hidden goal checks and stale-response handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Every target links to observed source evidence and coordinates remain correct after scaling.
No hidden evaluator labels enter model input.
Human takeover, cancellation, undo and branching cannot be overwritten by late responses.
Manual, recorded and generated evidence have distinct provenance.
Missing-target cases clarify or abstain within budget; complete goals are independently checked.
Keyboard region selection matches pointer controls and raw versus guarded actions remain visible.

evaluation.design: Authored study: 40 held-out screens × three goals × two visual conditions = 240 tasks; separate 20-screen development set. Four evidence modes × three repeats × at most three decisions gives at most 8640 evaluations/25920 typed answers, plus separately counted perception/tool calls. Freeze perception for a decision-only ablation and bootstrap by source screen. Full external ScreenSpot-v2: 1272 cases × three methods × three repeats = 11448 single-step evaluations, 576 batches of 20 before retries; adaptive three-step ceiling 34344. Use official point-in-box accuracy with invalid outputs counted and no gold-derived candidate proposals.
baselines: Deterministic OCR token matching and seeded random regions
Global caption, caption plus OCR and adaptive crop/OCR
Human-authored complete evidence as an explicit upper-bound intervention
Direct multimodal grounding as a separately budgeted condition
metrics: Independent goal completion and unsupported-action rate
Point-in-box accuracy by platform and text/icon; candidate recall
Evidence retention, tool budget, latency by stage, download/memory and provider failures
Paired source-screen bootstrap intervals and raw/guarded outcomes

coverage.current: One authored screenshot/task and three recorded decisions; 0/1272 external grounding cases. Offline probe is structural, not inference.
coverage.full: ScreenSpot-v2 pinned revision 5efbb1f1b5463a575f2eb7bc30fe29e49c15f93c has 334 desktop + 501 mobile + 437 web = 1272 instructions across 730 unique image filenames, counted from official JSON.
coverage.feasibility: Small annotations verified; no images/weights downloaded. Full evaluation needs images, image-derived candidates, local perception compute, scorer parity and a request budget. Hub auto-viewer fails, so load named annotation files directly.
